h1.en: Moved to New York in 2026? Here Is How to Get Health Coverage
h1.es: ¿Se Mudó a Nueva York en 2026? Así Se Consigue Cobertura Médica

subhero.en: You have 60 days from your move date to enroll at NY State of Health (nystateofhealth.ny.gov). New York is NOT on healthcare.gov, and the state offers a zero-premium Essential Plan for many movers.
subhero.es: Tiene 60 días desde la fecha de mudanza para inscribirse en NY State of Health (nystateofhealth.ny.gov). Nueva York NO usa healthcare.gov, y el estado ofrece un Plan Esencial con prima cero para muchos recién llegados.

heading.en: You have 60 days from your New York move date to enroll
heading.es: Tiene 60 días desde la fecha de mudanza a Nueva York para inscribirse

body.en: Your 60-day Special Enrollment Period runs from the day you move, for example June 11 through August 10 if you moved June 11, 2026. Miss that window and you must wait until the next ACA Open Enrollment in November 2026 (for 2027 coverage), unless another qualifying life event occurs. New York uses NY State of Health (nystateofhealth.ny.gov), NOT healthcare.gov. Enrolling on the wrong portal voids your application and delays your coverage start by a full month.
body.es: Su Período de Inscripción Especial de 60 días corre desde el día que se muda, por ejemplo del 11 de junio al 10 de agosto si se mudó el 11 de junio de 2026. Si pierde esa ventana, debe esperar hasta la próxima Inscripción Abierta del ACA en noviembre de 2026, a menos que ocurra otro evento calificador. Nueva York usa NY State of Health (nystateofhealth.ny.gov), NO healthcare.gov.

quickAnswer.en: Moving to New York triggers a 60-day Special Enrollment Period starting your move date. New York operates its own exchange, NY State of Health (nystateofhealth.ny.gov), so do NOT use healthcare.gov for enrollment. New York has four distinct coverage pathways depending on your income: (1) New York Medicaid (free, year-round) for income under 138% of the Federal Poverty Level ($22,025 single, $45,540 family of 4 in 2026); (2) New York Essential Plan (zero premium, minimal cost-sharing) for income from 138% to 200% FPL ($22,025 to $31,920 single in 2026), a Basic Health Program not available in most other states; (3) Qualified Health Plans on NY State of Health with premium tax credits for income 200% to 400% FPL; or (4) your employer's plan if it covers New York. To trigger the 60-day SEP, you must have had minimum essential coverage for at least one of the 60 days before your move date.
quickAnswer.es: Mudarse a Nueva York activa un Período de Inscripción Especial (SEP) de 60 días a partir de la fecha de mudanza. Nueva York opera su propio mercado, NY State of Health (nystateofhealth.ny.gov), por lo que NO debe usar healthcare.gov. Nueva York tiene cuatro vías de cobertura distintas: (1) Medicaid de Nueva York (gratis, todo el año) para ingresos bajo el 138% del Nivel Federal de Pobreza ($22,025 soltero, $45,540 familia de 4 en 2026); (2) Plan Esencial de Nueva York (prima cero, costos compartidos mínimos) para ingresos del 138% al 200% FPL; (3) Planes Calificados de Salud en NY State of Health con créditos fiscales de prima para ingresos del 200% al 400% FPL; o (4) el plan de su empleador si cubre Nueva York.

introParagraphs.en: Moving to New York puts you into one of the most consumer-protective health coverage systems in the country. New York operates NY State of Health (nystateofhealth.ny.gov), its own state-based marketplace that is completely separate from healthcare.gov. The state offers coverage options not available in most other states, most notably the Essential Plan, a Basic Health Program that provides zero-premium, low-cost-sharing coverage for adults earning 138% to 200% of the Federal Poverty Level. In 2026 that range runs from $22,025 to $31,920 per year for a single adult. The Essential Plan has dramatically lower cost-sharing than a subsidized Silver plan and no monthly premium, making it one of the best coverage values available anywhere in the US. Medicaid in New York covers adults at 138% FPL ($22,025 single, $45,540 family of 4 in 2026), and enrollment is year-round with no deadline once you establish residency. Your 60-day Special Enrollment Period is the critical clock: it starts on your move date and gives you 60 days to enroll in a Qualified Health Plan on NY State of Health if you do not immediately qualify for Medicaid or the Essential Plan. One condition most movers miss: the move-triggered SEP requires minimum essential coverage for at least one of the 60 days before your move date. Movers who were previously uninsured do not qualify for this SEP and must wait for Open Enrollment or another qualifying life event.
introParagraphs.es: Mudarse a Nueva York lo coloca en uno de los sistemas de cobertura médica más protectores para el consumidor del país. Nueva York opera NY State of Health (nystateofhealth.ny.gov), su propio mercado estatal completamente separado de healthcare.gov. El estado ofrece opciones de cobertura no disponibles en la mayoría de otros estados, especialmente el Plan Esencial, un Programa de Salud Básico que proporciona cobertura con prima cero y costos compartidos bajos para adultos que ganan entre el 138% y el 200% del Nivel Federal de Pobreza. En 2026, ese rango va de $22,025 a $31,920 al año para un adulto soltero. El Plan Esencial tiene costos compartidos mucho más bajos que un plan Silver subsidiado y sin prima mensual. Medicaid en Nueva York cubre adultos al 138% FPL ($22,025 soltero, $45,540 familia de 4 en 2026), con inscripción durante todo el año. Su SEP de 60 días comienza en la fecha de mudanza y le da 60 días para inscribirse en un Plan Calificado de Salud si no califica de inmediato para Medicaid o el Plan Esencial. Una condición que muchos pasan por alto: el SEP por mudanza requiere cobertura mínima esencial durante al menos uno de los 60 días antes de la fecha de mudanza.

introParagraphs.en: New York also has several features that distinguish it from most other states. New York imposes community rating rules that prohibit insurers from varying premiums by health status or claims history, which means Marketplace plan pricing in New York tends to be more stable than in states without those rules. New York's Child Health Plus (the state's branded CHIP program) covers children year-round at incomes up to 400% FPL with low or no premiums. New York does not have a state individual mandate penalty, so there is no state tax consequence if you have a gap in coverage after your move, but federal ACA rules still require you to have minimum essential coverage to use the move-triggered SEP. Movers from states without Medicaid expansion such as Florida, Texas, Georgia, or Alabama may qualify for New York Medicaid or the Essential Plan for the first time after their move, since New York fully expanded Medicaid and operates the Essential Plan as an additional coverage tier. Check the ACA income limits and Medicaid income limits using the household-size table below to determine which program fits your projected 2026 household income before you start your NY State of Health enrollment.
introParagraphs.es: Nueva York también tiene varias características que la distinguen de la mayoría de otros estados. Nueva York impone reglas de tarificación comunitaria que prohíben a los aseguradores variar las primas por estado de salud o historial de reclamaciones, lo que significa que los precios de los planes del Mercado en Nueva York tienden a ser más estables. Child Health Plus de Nueva York (el programa CHIP estatal) cubre niños durante todo el año con ingresos hasta el 400% FPL con primas bajas o nulas. Nueva York no tiene penalidad por mandato individual estatal. Los que se mudan de estados sin expansión de Medicaid como Florida, Texas, Georgia o Alabama pueden calificar por primera vez para Medicaid de Nueva York o el Plan Esencial, ya que Nueva York expandio completamente Medicaid y opera el Plan Esencial como un nivel de cobertura adicional. Consulte los límites de ingresos ACA y los límites de ingresos de Medicaid usando la tabla de tamaño del hogar a continuación para determinar qué programa se ajusta a su ingreso proyectado del hogar 2026.

name.en: Go to NY State of Health, not healthcare.gov
name.es: Vaya a NY State of Health, no a healthcare.gov

text.en: Log in or create an account at nystateofhealth.ny.gov. New York is a state-based marketplace and does NOT use the federal healthcare.gov platform. Enrolling on healthcare.gov will not give you access to New York plans, the Essential Plan, or New York Medicaid. If healthcare.gov redirects you, follow the redirect to nystateofhealth.ny.gov and complete your application there.
text.es: Inicie sesión o cree una cuenta en nystateofhealth.ny.gov. Nueva York es un mercado estatal y NO usa la plataforma federal healthcare.gov. Inscribirse en healthcare.gov no le dará acceso a los planes de Nueva York, el Plan Esencial, ni a Medicaid de Nueva York. Si healthcare.gov lo redirige, siga el redireccionamiento a nystateofhealth.ny.gov y complete su solicitud allí.

name.en: Report your move as a qualifying life event
name.es: Reporte su mudanza como evento calificador de vida

text.en: Select 'I moved to New York' as your qualifying life event on NY State of Health. Upload or submit proof of your New York address: a signed lease, utility bill, bank statement, or government-issued mail at the new address dated within 60 days. Also provide proof of prior minimum essential coverage for at least one of the 60 days before your move date, such as your prior insurance card, COBRA election notice, or 1095-A from a prior Marketplace plan.
text.es: Seleccione 'Me mudé a Nueva York' como su evento calificador de vida en NY State of Health. Suba o envíe prueba de su dirección en Nueva York: un contrato de arrendamiento firmado, factura de servicios, estado de cuenta bancario, o correo gubernamental en la nueva dirección con fecha dentro de 60 días. También proporcione prueba de cobertura mínima esencial anterior durante al menos uno de los 60 días antes de la fecha de mudanza.

name.es: Calcule su ingreso proyectado del hogar para 2026

text.en: ACA Marketplace premium tax credits and the Essential Plan both use Modified Adjusted Gross Income (MAGI) for your projected 2026 household income. Use what you expect to earn from your move date through December 31, 2026, not last year's income. For 2026, New York Medicaid covers income under 138% FPL ($22,025 single, $45,540 family of 4). The Essential Plan covers 138% to 200% FPL ($22,025 to $31,920 single). Premium tax credits apply from 200% to 400% FPL ($31,920 to $63,840 single) for standard Qualified Health Plans. Incomes above 400% FPL do not qualify for premium tax credits in 2026 because the enhanced ACA subsidies from the American Rescue Plan Act expired January 1, 2026.
text.es: Los créditos fiscales de prima del Mercado ACA y el Plan Esencial usan el Ingreso Bruto Ajustado Modificado (MAGI) de su ingreso proyectado del hogar para 2026. Use lo que espera ganar desde la fecha de mudanza hasta el 31 de diciembre de 2026. Para 2026, Medicaid de Nueva York cubre ingresos bajo el 138% FPL ($22,025 soltero, $45,540 familia de 4). El Plan Esencial cubre del 138% al 200% FPL. Los créditos fiscales de prima aplican del 200% al 400% FPL para Planes Calificados de Salud estándar. Los ingresos superiores al 400% FPL no califican para créditos fiscales de prima en 2026.

name.en: Apply for New York Medicaid or the Essential Plan first if income qualifies
name.es: Solicite primero Medicaid de Nueva York o el Plan Esencial si el ingreso califica

text.en: Apply through NY State of Health or your local Department of Social Services. New York Medicaid is free with year-round enrollment and no 60-day deadline once you establish residency. The Essential Plan (NY's Basic Health Program) provides near-zero-cost coverage at zero premium for adults at 138% to 200% FPL. Both programs cover comprehensive benefits including dental for adults in New York Medicaid. Medicaid processing in New York typically takes 15 to 45 days, but presumptive eligibility is available for pregnant women and certain other populations who may receive immediate temporary coverage while the application is reviewed.
text.es: Solicite a través de NY State of Health o su Departamento de Servicios Sociales local. Medicaid de Nueva York es gratuito con inscripción durante todo el año y sin plazo de 60 días una vez que establece residencia. El Plan Esencial proporciona cobertura de casi cero costo con prima cero para adultos al 138% al 200% FPL. Ambos programas cubren beneficios integrales. El procesamiento de Medicaid en Nueva York generalmente toma de 15 a 45 días, pero la elegibilidad presuntiva está disponible para mujeres embarazadas y ciertas otras poblaciones.

name.en: Compare Qualified Health Plans on NY State of Health if you do not qualify for Medicaid or the Essential Plan
name.es: Compare Planes Calificados de Salud en NY State of Health si no califica para Medicaid o el Plan Esencial

text.en: Log in to nystateofhealth.ny.gov and use the plan comparison tool to filter by your new New York ZIP code. Compare Silver, Gold, and Bronze plans by monthly premium after your premium tax credit, annual deductible, out-of-pocket maximum (up to $10,600 per individual in 2026), and the in-network provider directory for your specific area. Silver plans qualify for cost-sharing reductions if your income is 100% to 250% FPL. Coverage typically starts the first day of the month after you enroll. Enroll by the 15th of the month to ensure coverage starts on the first of the following month.
text.es: Inicie sesión en nystateofhealth.ny.gov y use la herramienta de comparación de planes filtrando por su nuevo código postal de Nueva York. Compare planes Silver, Gold y Bronze por prima mensual después del crédito fiscal, deducible anual, máximo de gastos de bolsillo (hasta $10,600 por individuo en 2026) y el directorio de proveedores en red. Los planes Silver califican para reducciones de costos compartidos si su ingreso es del 100% al 250% FPL. La cobertura generalmente comienza el primer día del mes siguiente a la inscripción.

name.en: Verify employer plan network coverage in New York
name.es: Verifique la cobertura de la red del plan del empleador en Nueva York

text.en: Call HR or check the plan's provider directory for your new New York ZIP code. PPO plans with national networks often cover New York providers. HMO and EPO plans are geographically restricted and may have no in-network providers in New York. If the employer plan's network does not cover your new area, request a Special Enrollment Period from HR under HIPAA Section 9831; most employers allow 30 days for a qualifying event window when you permanently relocate to a state outside the plan's network.
text.es: Llame a Recursos Humanos o revise el directorio de proveedores del plan para su nuevo código postal de Nueva York. Los planes PPO con redes nacionales frecuentemente cubren proveedores de Nueva York. Los planes HMO y EPO son geográficamente restringidos y pueden no tener proveedores en red en Nueva York. Si la red del plan del empleador no cubre su nueva área, solicite un Período de Inscripción Especial a través de Recursos Humanos bajo la Sección 9831 de HIPAA; la mayoría de los empleadores permiten 30 días para un evento calificador cuando se reubica permanentemente.

name.en: Enroll within 60 days and cancel your prior state coverage
name.es: Inscríbase dentro de los 60 días y cancele la cobertura de su estado anterior

text.en: Submit your NY State of Health enrollment no later than Day 60 from your move date. Then log in to your prior state's marketplace or healthcare.gov and terminate your previous plan effective your move date. If you had Medicaid in your prior state, notify that state's Medicaid agency in writing. Keep the termination confirmation as documentation, and watch for your 1095-A form at tax time; maintaining overlapping coverage creates subsidy reconciliation errors on your 2026 federal tax return. Medicaid has no deadline, but apply the same week you move to avoid a gap during the 15 to 45 day processing window.
text.es: Envíe su inscripción en NY State of Health no más tarde del día 60 desde la fecha de mudanza. Luego inicie sesión en el mercado de su estado anterior o healthcare.gov y cancele su plan anterior con vigencia a la fecha de mudanza. Si tenía Medicaid en su estado anterior, notifique a la agencia de Medicaid de ese estado por escrito. Guarde la confirmación de terminación y esté atento al formulario 1095-A en temporada de impuestos; mantener cobertura superpuesta crea errores de reconciliación de subsidios en su declaración federal de impuestos 2026. Medicaid no tiene fecha límite, pero solicite la misma semana que se muda.

COBRA from a prior state is almost never appropriate after a move to New York because the old plan network will not cover New York providers. Medicaid and Essential Plan enrollment are year-round. intro.en: The most costly mistakes people make when moving to New York in 2026:
intro.es: Los errores mas costosos que la gente comete al mudarse a Nueva York en 2026:

items.en: Using healthcare.gov instead of NY State of Health. New York is a state-based exchange. Applying through healthcare.gov will not enroll you in New York plans and may create a false confirmation that leaves you uncovered.
items.es: Usar healthcare.gov en lugar de NY State of Health. Nueva York es un mercado estatal. Solicitar a traves de healthcare.gov no lo inscribira en los planes de Nueva York y puede crear una confirmacion falsa que lo deja sin cobertura.

items.en: Overlooking the Essential Plan. New York's Essential Plan (zero premium, 138% to 200% FPL) is one of the best health coverage values in the country. Many movers never hear about it and enroll in a subsidized Silver plan that costs $50 to $200 per month more.
items.es: Ignorar el Plan Esencial. El Plan Esencial de Nueva York (prima cero, 138% al 200% FPL) es uno de los mejores valores de cobertura medica del pais. Muchos recien llegados nunca se enteran y se inscriben en un plan Silver subsidiado que cuesta $50 a $200 al mes mas.

items.en: Missing the prior-coverage requirement. The move-triggered 60-day SEP only applies if you had minimum essential coverage for at least one of the 60 days before your move date. Uninsured movers do not qualify for this SEP and must wait for Open Enrollment or another qualifying life event.
items.es: No cumplir el requisito de cobertura anterior. El SEP de 60 dias por mudanza solo aplica si tuvo cobertura minima esencial durante al menos uno de los 60 dias antes de la fecha de mudanza. Las personas sin seguro antes de mudarse no califican y deben esperar la Inscripcion Abierta u otro evento calificador.

items.en: Not reapplying for Medicaid. New York Medicaid does not transfer from other states. Apply through NY State of Health or your local Department of Social Services the same week you move; processing takes 15 to 45 days and there is no retroactive Marketplace coverage.
items.es: No volver a solicitar Medicaid. Medicaid de Nueva York no se transfiere desde otros estados. Solicite a traves de NY State of Health o su Departamento de Servicios Sociales local la misma semana que se mude; el procesamiento tarda de 15 a 45 dias y no hay cobertura retroactiva del Mercado.

items.en: Reporting prior-year income instead of projected 2026 income. NY State of Health uses projected Modified Adjusted Gross Income (MAGI) from your move date through December 31, 2026. Using last year's salary when your income has changed overstates or understates your eligibility for the Essential Plan and premium tax credits.
items.es: Reportar el ingreso del ano anterior en lugar del ingreso proyectado 2026. NY State of Health usa el Ingreso Bruto Ajustado Modificado (MAGI) proyectado desde la fecha de mudanza hasta el 31 de diciembre de 2026. Usar el salario del ano pasado cuando sus ingresos han cambiado puede afectar su elegibilidad para el Plan Esencial y los creditos fiscales.

items.en: Keeping overlapping coverage from the prior state active. Running two active plans creates subsidy reconciliation errors on the 1095-A form filed with your 2026 federal taxes, and the IRS may claw back premium tax credits received for months of duplicate coverage.
items.es: Mantener activa la cobertura superpuesta del estado anterior. Tener dos planes activos crea errores de reconciliacion de subsidios en el formulario 1095-A presentado con sus impuestos federales 2026, y el IRS puede recuperar los creditos fiscales de prima recibidos por meses de cobertura duplicada.

en.caption: New York Medicaid, Essential Plan, and ACA Marketplace subsidy income thresholds, 2026
en.footnote: New York Medicaid covers adults at 138% FPL and children at higher thresholds. The Essential Plan (Basic Health Program) covers adults at 138% to 200% FPL who are not Medicaid-eligible; it charges zero premium and minimal cost-sharing in 2026. The 400% FPL ACA subsidy cliff returned January 1, 2026 after enhanced PTCs expired. Incomes above 400% FPL do not qualify for premium tax credits. These thresholds apply to the 48 contiguous states plus DC; New York uses federal guidelines.
en.source: HHS ASPE 2026 Poverty Guidelines; CMS ACA premium tax credit thresholds 2026; CMS Basic Health Program 2026

El Plan Esencial cubre adultos al 138% al 200% FPL que no son elegibles para Medicaid; cobra prima cero y costos compartidos minimos en 2026. El techo del subsidio ACA del 400% FPL regreso el 1 de enero de 2026. Los ingresos superiores al 400% FPL no califican para creditos fiscales de prima.

en: Proof of New York address (signed lease or rental agreement, mortgage closing statement, utility bill at new address dated within 60 days, or government-issued mail at new New York address)

Proof of prior minimum essential coverage (insurance card from prior plan, COBRA election notice, 1095-A from a prior Marketplace plan, or employer plan termination letter) to satisfy the move-triggered SEP prior-coverage requirement
Social Security numbers for all household members applying for coverage

Proof of projected 2026 household income (recent pay stubs, most recent federal tax return, unemployment award letter, or self-employment income documentation) for NY State of Health income verification

Immigration documents if applicable (green card, employment authorization card, or visa) for lawfully present non-citizens; New York Medicaid covers many immigrant populations that federal rules exclude
Birth certificates or adoption papers for dependents being added to coverage
Prior state coverage termination confirmation (to avoid overlapping coverage and subsidy reconciliation problems on your 2026 federal tax return Form 1095-A)
es: Prueba de direccion en Nueva York (contrato de arrendamiento firmado, estado de cierre hipotecario, factura de servicios con fecha dentro de 60 dias en la nueva direccion, o correo gubernamental en la nueva direccion de Nueva York)

Prueba de cobertura minima esencial anterior (tarjeta de seguro del plan anterior, aviso de eleccion COBRA, formulario 1095-A de un plan del Mercado anterior, o carta de terminacion del plan del empleador) para cumplir el requisito de cobertura previa del SEP por mudanza
Numeros de Seguro Social de todos los miembros del hogar que solicitan cobertura

Prueba de ingreso proyectado del hogar para 2026 (talones de pago recientes, declaracion de impuestos federal mas reciente, carta de beneficios por desempleo, o documentacion de ingresos por cuenta propia) para verificacion de ingresos de NY State of Health

Documentos de inmigracion si aplica (tarjeta de residente permanente, tarjeta de autorizacion de empleo, o visa) para no ciudadanos con presencia legal; Medicaid de Nueva York cubre muchas poblaciones de inmigrantes que las reglas federales excluyen
Certificados de nacimiento o papeles de adopcion para dependientes que se agregan a la cobertura

Confirmacion de terminacion de cobertura del estado anterior (para evitar cobertura superpuesta y problemas de reconciliacion de subsidios en el formulario 1095-A de su declaracion de impuestos federal 2026)

stateRules.rule: Enroll through NY State of Health (nystateofhealth.ny.gov), not healthcare.gov. New York Medicaid covers adults at 138% FPL. The Essential Plan (zero premium, Basic Health Program under ACA Section 1331) covers adults at 138% to 200% FPL. Child Health Plus covers children at incomes up to 400% FPL. New York uses community rating rules prohibiting premium variation by health status. New York does not impose a state individual mandate penalty.

The Essential Plan is available to adults 19 to 64 who are U.S. citizens or lawfully present immigrants, earn 138% to 200% FPL, do not have access to employer-sponsored insurance covering at least 50% of the premium, and are not eligible for Medicaid. Essential Plan 1 (income 150% to 200% FPL) charges a small monthly premium; Essential Plan 2, 3, and 4 (income under 150% FPL) charge no premium. All tiers have minimal cost-sharing.

Child Health Plus is New York's CHIP program for children under 19. Coverage is year-round with income limits up to 400% FPL ($66,000 for a family of 4 in 2026). Children whose parents earn too much for Medicaid but whose family income is under 400% FPL can enroll in Child Health Plus at low or no cost. Apply through NY State of Health.

New York provides Medicaid to many immigrant populations that federal rules exclude, including undocumented adults for emergency services and certain lawfully present immigrants during the 5-year federal bar. New York's Essential Plan is available to lawfully present immigrants. Verify individual immigration category eligibility at NY State of Health.

en: Applying on healthcare.gov instead of NY State of Health (nystateofhealth.ny.gov): New York is a state-based marketplace, and healthcare.gov applications are not valid for New York plans, including the Essential Plan and New York Medicaid

Missing the prior-coverage requirement: the move-triggered 60-day SEP requires minimum essential coverage for at least one of the 60 days before the move date; applicants who were uninsured before moving do not qualify for this SEP
Insufficient proof of New York residency: undated documents, documents listing a prior address, or missing lease signatures cause NY State of Health to reject the qualifying event claim

Reporting prior-year income instead of projected 2026 Modified Adjusted Gross Income from the move date: this can incorrectly place the applicant in the wrong program tier (Medicaid vs Essential Plan vs Marketplace) or generate incorrect subsidy amounts

Applying after the 60-day SEP window: submitting to NY State of Health after Day 60 from the move date disqualifies the move as the qualifying event; the applicant must wait for the next ACA Open Enrollment (November 2026) or another qualifying life event
es: Solicitar en healthcare.gov en lugar de NY State of Health (nystateofhealth.ny.gov): Nueva York es un mercado estatal, y las solicitudes de healthcare.gov no son validas para los planes de Nueva York, incluyendo el Plan Esencial y Medicaid de Nueva York

No cumplir el requisito de cobertura anterior: el SEP de 60 dias por mudanza requiere cobertura minima esencial durante al menos uno de los 60 dias antes de la fecha de mudanza; los solicitantes sin seguro antes de mudarse no califican para este SEP

Prueba de residencia en Nueva York insuficiente: documentos sin fecha, documentos con una direccion anterior, o contratos de arrendamiento sin firmas hacen que NY State of Health rechace la reclamacion del evento calificador

Reportar el ingreso del ano anterior en lugar del Ingreso Bruto Ajustado Modificado proyectado 2026 desde la fecha de mudanza: esto puede colocar incorrectamente al solicitante en el nivel de programa equivocado o generar montos de subsidio incorrectos

Solicitar despues de la ventana del SEP de 60 dias: presentar en NY State of Health despues del dia 60 desde la fecha de mudanza descalifica la mudanza como evento calificador; el solicitante debe esperar la proxima Inscripcion Abierta del ACA (noviembre 2026) u otro evento calificador de vida

heading.en: Medicaid vs Essential Plan vs Marketplace vs COBRA: Which New York Coverage Path Fits You?
heading.es: Medicaid vs Plan Esencial vs Mercado vs COBRA: ¿Que Via de Cobertura de Nueva York Es Para Usted?

body.en: New York offers more coverage tiers than almost any other state, so the decision matrix is more structured than most. Medicaid first: free, year-round, no network enrollment restriction in most cases, and covers adults at incomes up to 138% FPL ($22,025 for a single person, $45,540 for a family of 4 in 2026 per HHS ASPE 2026 Poverty Guidelines). Apply through NY State of Health or a local Department of Social Services the same week you move. Essential Plan second: if your income falls between 138% and 200% FPL ($22,025 to $31,920 single in 2026), the Essential Plan charges zero premium (for EP tiers 2, 3, and 4, covering those below 150% FPL) or a very small premium (EP tier 1, 150% to 200% FPL), with minimal cost-sharing. This is a dramatically better deal than a subsidized Silver Marketplace plan for most people in that income band. Qualified Health Plan on NY State of Health third: for incomes above 200% FPL up to 400% FPL ($31,920 to $63,840 single in 2026), use your 60-day SEP to enroll in a subsidized Silver, Gold, or Bronze plan on nystateofhealth.ny.gov. Premium tax credits reduce most enrollees to $30 to $400 per month depending on income and plan tier. Employer plan fourth, if available: call HR within 30 days of your move to request the employer plan's qualifying event window under HIPAA Section 9831. A national PPO may already cover New York providers; an HMO or EPO likely does not. COBRA from a prior state is the last resort: it runs 102% of the full premium ($500 to $2,000 per month in 2026) and the old plan's network is in the state you left, meaning all routine care in New York is out-of-network. COBRA only makes sense if you have ongoing specialist treatment at the prior location that you cannot interrupt for 30 to 90 days while your new plan's network is established.
body.es: Nueva York ofrece mas niveles de cobertura que casi cualquier otro estado, por lo que la matriz de decision es mas estructurada. Medicaid primero: gratuito, todo el ano, sin restriccion de inscripcion en red en la mayoria de los casos, y cubre adultos con ingresos hasta el 138% FPL ($22,025 para una persona sola, $45,540 para una familia de 4 en 2026). Solicite a traves de NY State of Health o un Departamento de Servicios Sociales local la misma semana que se mude. Plan Esencial segundo: si su ingreso cae entre el 138% y el 200% FPL, el Plan Esencial cobra prima cero (para los niveles EP 2, 3 y 4, cubriendo a los que estan por debajo del 150% FPL) o una prima muy pequena (nivel EP 1, 150% al 200% FPL), con costos compartidos minimos. Plan Calificado de Salud en NY State of Health tercero: para ingresos superiores al 200% FPL hasta el 400% FPL, use su SEP de 60 dias para inscribirse en un plan Silver, Gold o Bronze subsidiado. Plan del empleador cuarto si esta disponible: llame a Recursos Humanos dentro de los 30 dias de su mudanza. COBRA del estado anterior es el ultimo recurso: cobra el 102% de la prima completa ($500 a $2,000 al mes en 2026) y la red del plan anterior esta en el estado que dejo, lo que significa que toda la atencion de rutina en Nueva York esta fuera de la red.

heading.en: New York Essential Plan: The Zero-Premium Option Most Movers Miss
heading.es: Plan Esencial de Nueva York: La Opcion de Prima Cero que la Mayoria de Recien Llegados No Conoce

paragraphs.en: New York's Essential Plan is one of the only Basic Health Programs operating in the US in 2026 (Minnesota's MinnesotaCare is the other). It is authorized under ACA Section 1331 and funded by both federal and state dollars. The Essential Plan covers adults ages 19 to 64 who are US citizens or lawfully present immigrants, whose income falls between 138% and 200% of the Federal Poverty Level ($22,025 to $31,920 for a single adult in 2026), who do not have access to affordable employer-sponsored insurance, and who do not qualify for Medicaid. The program has four tiers based on income: Essential Plan 1 (150% to 200% FPL) carries a small monthly premium around $20 per month; Essential Plans 2, 3, and 4 (under 150% FPL) charge zero premium. All four tiers have low copays, no deductible for most services, and an annual out-of-pocket maximum significantly below the ACA Marketplace limit of $10,600. The Essential Plan is not available in most US states, so movers from other states often have never heard of it. For someone earning $25,000 to $31,000 per year as a single person who just moved to New York, the Essential Plan typically saves $2,400 to $4,000 annually compared to a subsidized Marketplace Silver plan.
paragraphs.es: El Plan Esencial de Nueva York es uno de los unicos Programas de Salud Basicos que operan en EE.UU. en 2026 (MinnesotaCare de Minnesota es el otro). Esta autorizado bajo la Seccion 1331 del ACA y financiado por fondos federales y estatales. El Plan Esencial cubre adultos de 19 a 64 anos que son ciudadanos estadounidenses o inmigrantes con presencia legal, cuyo ingreso cae entre el 138% y el 200% del Nivel Federal de Pobreza ($22,025 a $31,920 para un adulto soltero en 2026), que no tienen acceso a seguro patrocinado por empleador asequible, y que no califican para Medicaid. El programa tiene cuatro niveles basados en el ingreso: el Plan Esencial 1 (150% al 200% FPL) tiene una prima mensual pequena de alrededor de $20 al mes; los Planes Esenciales 2, 3 y 4 (bajo el 150% FPL) cobran prima cero. Los cuatro niveles tienen copagos bajos, sin deducible para la mayoria de los servicios, y un maximo de gastos de bolsillo anual significativamente por debajo del limite del Mercado ACA de $10,600.

paragraphs.en: Movers from Florida, Texas, Georgia, South Carolina, or any other non-expansion state who land in New York for the first time often find they now qualify for either Medicaid or the Essential Plan. Medicaid in those states was largely unavailable to adults without qualifying dependents. New York's Medicaid covers adults at 138% FPL regardless of family structure. NY State of Health determines eligibility for both Medicaid and the Essential Plan in a single application, so you do not need to apply separately; the system routes your application to the correct program based on your household size, income, immigration status, and access to employer coverage. Apply through NY State of Health (nystateofhealth.ny.gov) and the eligibility determination typically takes 15 to 45 days for Medicaid and 30 to 45 days for the Essential Plan.
paragraphs.es: Los que se mudan desde Florida, Texas, Georgia, Carolina del Sur, u otro estado sin expansion que llegan a Nueva York por primera vez a menudo descubren que ahora califican para Medicaid o el Plan Esencial. Medicaid en esos estados era en gran parte no disponible para adultos sin dependientes calificados. Medicaid de Nueva York cubre adultos al 138% FPL independientemente de la estructura familiar. NY State of Health determina la elegibilidad tanto para Medicaid como para el Plan Esencial en una sola solicitud; el sistema dirige su solicitud al programa correcto basandose en el tamano del hogar, ingreso, estado migratorio y acceso a cobertura del empleador.

heading.en: NY State of Health vs Healthcare.gov: Why the Portal You Use Changes Everything
heading.es: NY State of Health vs Healthcare.gov: Por Que el Portal que Usa lo Cambia Todo

paragraphs.en: New York is a state-based marketplace under ACA Section 1311, operating nystateofhealth.ny.gov completely independently from healthcare.gov since 2014. Only plans sold through NY State of Health count as qualifying coverage for New York residents during Special Enrollment Periods. Healthcare.gov does not list New York plans, does not connect to the Essential Plan, and does not route to New York Medicaid. If you apply on healthcare.gov after moving to New York, you may receive a confirmation message that is technically valid for the federal system but covers no New York providers and does not satisfy New York's coverage requirements. The practical fix is to start fresh at nystateofhealth.ny.gov, enter your new New York address, report your move as the qualifying event, and upload your residency documentation. NY State of Health's consumer-support line is 1-855-355-5777 (Monday through Friday 8 AM to 8 PM ET, and Saturday 9 AM to 1 PM ET) for enrollment assistance. Certified application assistors (also called navigators) are available in person in most New York counties at no cost; find them through NY State of Health's navigator directory.
paragraphs.es: Nueva York es un mercado estatal bajo la Seccion 1311 del ACA, operando nystateofhealth.ny.gov completamente independiente de healthcare.gov desde 2014. Solo los planes vendidos a traves de NY State of Health cuentan como cobertura calificada para residentes de Nueva York durante los Periodos de Inscripcion Especial. Healthcare.gov no lista planes de Nueva York, no conecta al Plan Esencial y no dirige a Medicaid de Nueva York. Si solicita en healthcare.gov despues de mudarse a Nueva York, puede recibir un mensaje de confirmacion que es tecnicamente valido para el sistema federal pero que no cubre proveedores de Nueva York. La solucion practica es comenzar de nuevo en nystateofhealth.ny.gov. La linea de soporte al consumidor de NY State of Health es 1-855-355-5777 para asistencia en la inscripcion.

paragraphs.en: NY State of Health also offers programs and enrollment pathways not visible on healthcare.gov. The Essential Plan is exclusively administered through NY State of Health. Child Health Plus enrollment for children is processed through NY State of Health or through local Medicaid offices. NY State of Health's Small Business Marketplace (NY SHOP) is also separate from the federal SHOP marketplace. If you are a small business owner who moved to New York, compare NY SHOP plans for your employees through ny.gov/SHOP rather than the federal portal. The enrollment process on NY State of Health mirrors healthcare.gov in most respects: create an account, enter household members, report the qualifying life event (move to New York), enter income, and select a plan. Coverage typically starts the first of the month following enrollment for Marketplace plans, and NY State of Health displays the exact coverage start date during the enrollment flow before you confirm your plan selection.
paragraphs.es: NY State of Health tambien ofrece programas y rutas de inscripcion no visibles en healthcare.gov. El Plan Esencial se administra exclusivamente a traves de NY State of Health. La inscripcion de Child Health Plus para ninos se procesa a traves de NY State of Health o de las oficinas locales de Medicaid. NY State of Health's Small Business Marketplace (NY SHOP) tambien es separado del mercado federal SHOP. Si es dueno de una pequena empresa que se mudo a Nueva York, compare los planes NY SHOP para sus empleados a traves de ny.gov/SHOP en lugar del portal federal. El proceso de inscripcion en NY State of Health refleja el de healthcare.gov en la mayoria de los aspectos.

heading.en: Child Health Plus: New York CHIP Coverage for Children After Your Move
heading.es: Child Health Plus: Cobertura CHIP de Nueva York para Ninos Despues de su Mudanza

paragraphs.en: Child Health Plus is New York's branded Children's Health Insurance Program (CHIP). Coverage for children does not transfer from another state's CHIP program; your children's CHIP enrollment must restart in New York. Child Health Plus enrollment is year-round through NY State of Health or a local Department of Social Services, with no 60-day deadline. Income limits for Child Health Plus run up to 400% FPL ($66,000 for a family of 4 in 2026). Children in families above 400% FPL may still enroll in Child Health Plus at full cost if they cannot access employer-sponsored coverage, though this is uncommon. Child Health Plus covers comprehensive benefits including preventive care, dental and orthodontics (limited), vision, mental health, and substance use disorder services. Premiums range from zero for very low-income families to modest amounts for families near 300% to 400% FPL. To enroll, apply through nystateofhealth.ny.gov and indicate you have children to add; NY State of Health automatically screens for Child Health Plus eligibility as part of the family application.
paragraphs.es: Child Health Plus es el programa CHIP con marca de Nueva York. La cobertura de los ninos no se transfiere desde el programa CHIP de otro estado; la inscripcion CHIP de sus hijos debe reiniciarse en Nueva York. La inscripcion en Child Health Plus es durante todo el ano a traves de NY State of Health o un Departamento de Servicios Sociales local, sin plazo de 60 dias. Los limites de ingresos para Child Health Plus alcanzan hasta el 400% FPL ($66,000 para una familia de 4 en 2026). Child Health Plus cubre beneficios integrales incluyendo atencion preventiva, dental, vision, salud mental y servicios de trastornos por uso de sustancias. Las primas van desde cero para familias de muy bajos ingresos hasta cantidades modestas para familias cerca del 300% al 400% FPL. Para inscribirse, solicite a traves de nystateofhealth.ny.gov e indique que tiene ninos que agregar.

en.question: Does moving to New York trigger a Special Enrollment Period?
en.answer: Yes. Permanently moving to New York where different qualified health plans are available triggers a 60-day Special Enrollment Period for ACA Marketplace plans. The 60-day SEP clock starts on your move date, for example June 11, 2026, through August 10, 2026, if you move on June 11. One important condition applies: you must have had minimum essential coverage for at least one of the 60 days before your move date. People who were uninsured before moving to New York do not qualify for the move-triggered SEP and must wait for Open Enrollment or another qualifying life event.

en.question: Which website do I use to enroll in health insurance in New York?
en.answer: Use NY State of Health at nystateofhealth.ny.gov, not healthcare.gov. New York is a state-based marketplace and operates completely separately from the federal platform. Healthcare.gov will NOT show you New York plans, the Essential Plan, or New York Medicaid. Enrolling on the wrong portal will not give you valid coverage and may result in a gap in your health insurance. NY State of Health's consumer helpline is 1-855-355-5777 for enrollment assistance Monday through Friday.

en.question: What is the New York Essential Plan and do I qualify after moving?
en.answer: The Essential Plan is New York's Basic Health Program under ACA Section 1331. It covers adults 19 to 64 with incomes between 138% and 200% FPL ($22,025 to $31,920 for a single adult in 2026) who are not eligible for Medicaid and do not have access to affordable employer-sponsored coverage. Most tiers charge zero premium and very low copays. Essential Plan 1 (150% to 200% FPL) charges a small monthly premium around $20. If you move to New York with income in that range, you may qualify for the Essential Plan immediately upon establishing residency and applying through NY State of Health. Enrollment in the Essential Plan is year-round.

en.question: Does New York Medicaid transfer from another state?
en.answer: No. Medicaid does not transfer between states. Federal Medicaid law requires your old state to terminate your coverage when you establish residency in New York. New York Medicaid requires a fresh application through NY State of Health or a local Department of Social Services. Processing typically takes 15 to 45 days. New York Medicaid covers adults at incomes up to 138% FPL ($22,025 single, $45,540 family of 4 in 2026) and is year-round with no 60-day deadline. Apply the same week you move to minimize the coverage gap during processing.

en.question: What documents do I need to prove I moved to New York for the SEP?
en.answer: NY State of Health requires proof of your New York address and proof of prior coverage. Acceptable address documents include a signed lease or rental agreement, mortgage closing statement, utility bill (electric, gas, water) dated within 60 days at the new address, government-issued mail at the new address, or a bank statement showing the new address. Proof of prior coverage can be your prior insurance card, a COBRA election notice, a 1095-A from a prior Marketplace plan, or an employer plan termination letter. Having all documents ready before you log in to nystateofhealth.ny.gov reduces the application review time from 30 days to under a week.

en.question: What if I miss the 60-day SEP after moving to New York?
en.answer: If you miss the 60-day Marketplace SEP, you generally must wait until the next ACA Open Enrollment, which runs November 1, 2026 through January 15, 2027 for 2027 coverage. New York Medicaid and the Essential Plan do not have a 60-day deadline; they are year-round programs for those who qualify. If your income drops to Medicaid-qualifying levels (under 138% FPL) after missing the SEP, that income change itself may create a new qualifying life event. One emergency room visit without coverage costs $3,000 to $20,000; the 2026 ACA out-of-pocket maximum for Marketplace plans is $10,600 per individual.

en.question: What happens to my children's health coverage when I move to New York?
en.answer: Children's coverage does not transfer from other states. Enroll your children in New York coverage through NY State of Health immediately after your move. Child Health Plus is New York's CHIP program and covers children under 19 at incomes up to 400% FPL ($66,000 for a family of 4 in 2026). Child Health Plus enrollment is year-round with no 60-day deadline. Low-income children under 138% FPL qualify for New York Medicaid directly. Apply for your children through the same NY State of Health application as yourself; the system screens for all programs including Child Health Plus automatically.

en.question: I moved from a non-expansion state like Florida or Texas. Do I now qualify for New York Medicaid?
en.answer: Likely yes, if your income is under 138% FPL. New York fully expanded Medicaid under the ACA. Florida and Texas have not expanded Medicaid, so most adults without qualifying dependents received no Medicaid there regardless of income. New York Medicaid covers adults at incomes up to 138% FPL ($22,025 single, $45,540 family of 4 in 2026) regardless of family structure. Apply through NY State of Health (nystateofhealth.ny.gov) as soon as you have proof of your New York address. If your income is between 138% and 200% FPL, you may qualify for the Essential Plan instead.

es.question: ¿Mudarse a Nueva York activa un Periodo de Inscripcion Especial?
es.answer: Si. Mudarse permanentemente a Nueva York donde hay diferentes planes de salud calificados disponibles activa un Periodo de Inscripcion Especial de 60 dias para los planes del Mercado ACA. El reloj del SEP comienza en la fecha de mudanza, por ejemplo del 11 de junio de 2026 al 10 de agosto de 2026, si se muda el 11 de junio. Una condicion importante: debe haber tenido cobertura minima esencial durante al menos uno de los 60 dias antes de la fecha de mudanza. Las personas sin seguro antes de mudarse a Nueva York no califican para el SEP por mudanza y deben esperar la Inscripcion Abierta u otro evento calificador.

es.question: ¿Que sitio web uso para inscribirme en seguro medico en Nueva York?
es.answer: Use NY State of Health en nystateofhealth.ny.gov, no healthcare.gov. Nueva York es un mercado estatal y opera completamente separado de la plataforma federal. Healthcare.gov NO mostrara los planes de Nueva York, el Plan Esencial, ni Medicaid de Nueva York. Inscribirse en el portal equivocado no le dara cobertura valida y puede resultar en una brecha en su seguro medico. La linea de ayuda al consumidor de NY State of Health es 1-855-355-5777 para asistencia en la inscripcion de lunes a viernes.

es.question: ¿Que es el Plan Esencial de Nueva York y califico despues de mudarme?
es.answer: El Plan Esencial es el Programa de Salud Basico de Nueva York bajo la Seccion 1331 del ACA. Cubre adultos de 19 a 64 anos con ingresos entre el 138% y el 200% FPL ($22,025 a $31,920 para un adulto soltero en 2026) que no son elegibles para Medicaid y no tienen acceso a cobertura del empleador asequible. La mayoria de los niveles cobran prima cero y copagos muy bajos. El Plan Esencial 1 (150% al 200% FPL) cobra una prima mensual pequena de aproximadamente $20. Si se muda a Nueva York con ingresos en ese rango, puede calificar para el Plan Esencial de inmediato al establecer residencia y solicitar a traves de NY State of Health.

es.question: ¿El Medicaid de Nueva York se transfiere desde otro estado?
es.answer: No. Medicaid no se transfiere entre estados. La ley federal de Medicaid requiere que su estado anterior termine su cobertura cuando establece residencia en Nueva York. Medicaid de Nueva York requiere una nueva solicitud a traves de NY State of Health o un Departamento de Servicios Sociales local. El procesamiento suele tardar de 15 a 45 dias. Medicaid de Nueva York cubre adultos con ingresos hasta el 138% FPL ($22,025 soltero, $45,540 familia de 4 en 2026) y es durante todo el ano sin plazo de 60 dias. Solicite la misma semana que se mude para minimizar la brecha de cobertura durante el procesamiento.

es.question: ¿Que documentos necesito para probar que me mude a Nueva York para el SEP?
es.answer: NY State of Health requiere prueba de su direccion en Nueva York y prueba de cobertura anterior. Los documentos de direccion aceptables incluyen un contrato de arrendamiento firmado, estado de cierre hipotecario, factura de servicios con fecha dentro de 60 dias en la nueva direccion, correo gubernamental en la nueva direccion, o estado de cuenta bancario con la nueva direccion. La prueba de cobertura anterior puede ser su tarjeta de seguro anterior, un aviso de eleccion COBRA, un formulario 1095-A de un plan del Mercado anterior, o una carta de terminacion del plan del empleador. Tener todos los documentos listos antes de iniciar sesion en nystateofhealth.ny.gov reduce el tiempo de revision de la solicitud.

es.question: ¿Que pasa si pierdo el SEP de 60 dias despues de mudarme a Nueva York?
es.answer: Si pierde el SEP del Mercado de 60 dias, generalmente debe esperar hasta la proxima Inscripcion Abierta del ACA, que va del 1 de noviembre de 2026 al 15 de enero de 2027 para cobertura 2027. Medicaid de Nueva York y el Plan Esencial no tienen un plazo de 60 dias; son programas durante todo el ano para quienes califican. Si su ingreso cae al nivel de Medicaid (bajo el 138% FPL) despues de perder el SEP, ese cambio de ingresos puede crear un nuevo evento calificador de vida. Una visita a urgencias sin cobertura cuesta de $3,000 a $20,000; el maximo de gastos de bolsillo del ACA 2026 para planes del Mercado es de $10,600 por individuo.

es.question: ¿Que pasa con la cobertura medica de mis hijos cuando me mudo a Nueva York?
es.answer: La cobertura de los ninos no se transfiere desde otros estados. Inscriba a sus hijos en la cobertura de Nueva York a traves de NY State of Health inmediatamente despues de su mudanza. Child Health Plus es el programa CHIP de Nueva York y cubre ninos menores de 19 anos con ingresos hasta el 400% FPL ($66,000 para una familia de 4 en 2026). La inscripcion en Child Health Plus es durante todo el ano sin plazo de 60 dias. Los ninos de bajos ingresos bajo el 138% FPL califican directamente para Medicaid de Nueva York. Solicite para sus hijos a traves de la misma solicitud de NY State of Health que usted; el sistema verifica automaticamente todos los programas.

es.question: Me mude desde un estado sin expansion como Florida o Texas. ¿Ahora califico para Medicaid de Nueva York?
es.answer: Probablemente si, si su ingreso esta bajo el 138% FPL. Nueva York expandio completamente Medicaid bajo el ACA. Florida y Texas no han expandido Medicaid, por lo que la mayoria de los adultos sin dependientes calificados no recibieron Medicaid alli sin importar el ingreso. Medicaid de Nueva York cubre adultos con ingresos hasta el 138% FPL ($22,025 soltero, $45,540 familia de 4 en 2026) independientemente de la estructura familiar. Solicite a traves de NY State of Health (nystateofhealth.ny.gov) tan pronto como tenga prueba de su direccion en Nueva York. Si su ingreso esta entre el 138% y el 200% FPL, puede calificar para el Plan Esencial.

note.en: Federal authority for New York's Essential Plan as a Basic Health Program under ACA Section 1331. Covers adults at 138% to 200% FPL not eligible for Medicaid.
note.es: Autoridad federal para el Plan Esencial de Nueva York como Programa de Salud Basico bajo la Seccion 1331 del ACA. Cubre adultos al 138% al 200% FPL no elegibles para Medicaid.

note.en: Official 2026 Federal Poverty Level guidelines used to calculate New York Medicaid eligibility at 138% FPL, Essential Plan eligibility at 138% to 200% FPL, and ACA subsidy eligibility at 100% to 400% FPL.
note.es: Directrices oficiales del Nivel Federal de Pobreza 2026 usadas para calcular la elegibilidad de Medicaid de Nueva York al 138% FPL, del Plan Esencial al 138% al 200% FPL, y del subsidio ACA del 100% al 400% FPL.

sources.name: KFF: Status of State Medicaid Expansion Decisions 2026

note.en: Confirms New York expanded Medicaid under the ACA. Documents the 10 non-expansion states as of 2026 and their coverage gap implications for movers from those states.
note.es: Confirma que Nueva York expandio Medicaid bajo el ACA. Documenta los 10 estados sin expansion a partir de 2026 y las implicaciones de la brecha de cobertura para quienes se mudan desde esos estados.
